kind.content: Simple food, cooked carefully. Everything is made here, from the bread to the ice cream.
Soft scrambled eggs, brown butter, chives, toasted sourdough
Baked at six, glazed with orange syrup; two per plate
Chard, leek, feta, soft eggs, flatbread
Brown butter, sea herbs, crushed new potatoes
Miso butter, toasted hazelnuts, pickled shallot
Leeks, crème fraîche, grilled bread for the broth
Vanilla cream, oat crumble, thyme honey
Salted caramel, a little sea salt
Vegetarian and gluten-free versions of most dishes. Just ask.
